propositions: A reusable gate-duration probe must persist in scripts/rebar_duration_probe.py as a stdlib-only CLI/reporting layer with documented command reproducing frozen analysis
The probe must parse rollout logs from configurable --log-root and .tickets-tracker, with optional ISO-8601 bounds and provider filtering, accepting unbounded or current-regime cohorts
Gated-close phase breakdown must distinguish direct metrics, direct event intervals, and inferred residuals, reading COMPLETION_VERDICT, STATUS, and SIGNATURE timestamps
The probe must classify operations (no-LLM, forced, status/check/help, unmatched, interrupted) as distinguishable from completed model-backed cohorts
Rollout parsing and statistical primitives must be extracted to scripts/rebar_duration_probe_support.py to keep the CLI layer below 800 lines
The implementation must pass import-walk checks, 17 focused synthetic tests, and lint/typecheck gates without changing agent-duration guidance
